Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the father of Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart (1794–1859) as John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart, who died in 1794. This creates a chronological impossibility (a father dying before his son is born). The error stems from the Planner failing to verify the genealogical accuracy of the initial search snippet or recognizing the inconsistency between the father's death date and the son's birth date. Instead of correcting this or searching for the actual father (John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute, who was alive in 1794), the Planner proceeded with the flawed lineage, leading to repeated incorrect search queries and an inability to resolve the ambiguity properly.
